cd /tmp && python3 << 'EOF'
target = ".....((((((((....))))((((.((((....))))(((((....))))).((((....))))))))((((....))))))))...................."
n = len(target)
stack = []
pairs = {}
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c == '(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c == ')':
        j = stack.pop()
        pairs[j] = i
        pairs[i] = j

seq = ['A']*n

# tetraloop hairpin loops (4nt) at these regions
loops = [(13,16),(30,33),(43,46),(57,60),(73,76)]
for (a,b) in loops:
    for k,ch in zip(range(a,b+1),"GAAA"):
        seq[k]=ch

# assign stems with GC pairs, alternate GC/CG per pair depth for variety
gc_cycle = ['G','C','C','G']
idx=0
done=set()
for i in range(n):
    j = pairs.get(i,-1)
    if j==-1 or i in done or j in done:
        continue
    if i<j:
        a,b = i,j
    else:
        a,b = j,i
    if a in loops or True:
        pass
    g = gc_cycle[idx%4]
    c = {'G':'C','C':'G'}[g]
    seq[a]=g
    seq[b]=c
    done.add(a); done.add(b)
    idx+=1

seq = ''.join(seq)
print(seq)
print(len(seq))
EOF
